svg.title: Conditional TypTop application diagram
svg.desc: A four-step flow shows a user entering a password, the client encrypting with Conditional Encryption, the server checking private typo predicates, and access being granted only if the predicate holds. A comparison shows that without Conditional Encryption privacy can be at risk, while with Conditional Encryption the server learns only whether the password matches or is an allowed typo.

g.text: Conditional Encryption lets the server check whether a login attempt is the real
password or an allowed typo, while keeping the real password private.
